visible_item.prompt: Maya started her job at the shop on Monday. Complete the sentence using “work”: Before Monday, she [____] at the shop.
visible_item.target_answer: Before Monday, she had not been working at the shop.

target_fidelity.question: Does the target answer express exactly the intended GrammarCell?
